benchmark.baseline_note: Issues 77 and 78 have no experiment records in the derived catalog at the time of this change; the comparison baseline is the measured issue-52 real-agent peak plus the issue-56 anon-mmap finding. A resourced fork builder must re-run the lite binary against the same harness and record the delta.
benchmark.method: python3 automation/memory_benchmark.py --include-network for the full binary; static import-graph closure plus the deterministic representative coding task in automation/opencode_lite.py for the lite path until a resourced bun build exists

boundaries.custom_provider_guard: The lite entrypoint must not introduce a direct provider/API client. All model access stays through the existing OpenCode provider/model/session/agent loop. Static imports of third-party LLM SDKs or hard-coded provider API hosts outside packages/opencode/src/provider/** fail validation.

modules: update/model-catalog helpers not needed with explicit configuration
removed_groups.rationale: No dependency from the headless provider/agent/tool loop; safe to compile-separate first.
Tool-registry only. The minimal coding set (read/search/edit/write/patch/shell) does not need them.

Adjacent to the agent loop, so removed last and validated against the representative coding task. The task tool keeps the generic name, so validation matches path-qualified agent/task and subagent patterns rather than a bare task substring.
